Obituary - Elizabeth Ann Schlechty
item.description: Elizabeth Ann Schlechty, 78, of Adrian, MO, passed away on Thursday, January 15, 2026, at home. The funeral service will be held on Saturday, January 24, 2026, at 11:00 AM at Atkinson Funeral Home in Adrian, MO, followed by interment at Crescent Hill Cemetery, with a visitation at 10:00 AM. Memorial contributions can be given to the BCMH Auxiliary. A full obituary will be posted when it is available.

item.title: Obituary - Richard Cooley
item.description: Richard LeRoy Cooley, 85, passed away on Wednesday, January 14, 2026, at his home in Nevada, MO. Richard was born in Kanosh, Utah on August 12th, 1940 to Edna Lucille (Barney) and Anthon LeRoy Cooley. He married Leah Tryon on June 27, 1968 in Mesa, Arizona and she survives of the home. Richard was born with a wandering spirit which took him all over the countryside until his dad put him to work at age 5. He graduated from high school in 1958 as a Utah State wrestling champion. item.title: Confirmed: Metz depot to be rehomed at Frontier Village
item.description: Following numerous discussions and several visits to the current location of the Metz, MO depot, it has been determined that it is structurally sound enough to make the trip to its future home at Frontier Village in Adrian.Much like the Mt. Vernon school and several other buildings that have been relocated to the village, it will undergo a complete renovation over time to be preserved for the appreciation of future generations.Mid America Live will provide updates on the project accordingly.
